result: Lean module PregenesisKItemDeltaGrammar compiles under Lean 4.35.0 with pinned Mathlib v4.35.0, built through lake from the non-default PregenesisKItemDeltaGrammar library. Printed axioms are among propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. The outcome is Narrowed: one empty base, two data, arity one, and a 10-atom census of length at most 2, not a k-item grammar.
proof_boundary: On one empty base with data count 2, the 10-atom universe of a fresh datum, one unary form, two rule targets and six unary instances has 9 well-formed deltas of length at most 2. Two of them separate the target bits. Seven do not. The form-rule delta sets both bits true. A 3-item rule extension equalizes the bits of the argument-0 instance, and a 3-item instance of argument 2 keeps both target bits false. Arity two and a grammar past two items are outside this module. The node stays OPEN.
